shortDescription: Manage schedule objects on PAN-OS devices.

options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: daily_time
options.description: Time range (e.x. '17:00-19:00') for a daily recurring schedule

options.name: device_group
options.description: (Panorama only) The device group the operation should target.

options.name: disable_override
options.description: If the override is disabled

options.name: gathered_filter
options.description: When I(state=gathered). An advanced filtering option to filter results returned from PAN-OS. Refer to the guide discussing I(gathered_filter) for more information.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The IP address or hostname of the PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the object.

options.name: non_recurring_date_time
options.description: Date and time range string (e.x. '2019/11/01@00:15-2019/11/28@00:30') for a non-recurring schedule

options.name: password
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The password to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: port
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The port number to connect to the PAN-OS device on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: recurrence
options.description: Recurrence schedule

options.name: state
options.description: The state.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of schedule

options.name: username
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The username to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: vsys
options.description: The vsys this object belongs to.

options.name: weekly_friday_time
options.description: Time range (e.x. '17:00-19:00') for a weekly recurring schedule (Friday)

options.name: weekly_monday_time
options.description: Time range (e.x. '17:00-19:00') for a weekly recurring schedule (Monday)

options.name: weekly_saturday_time
options.description: Time range (e.x. '17:00-19:00') for a weekly recurring schedule (Saturday)

options.name: weekly_sunday_time
options.description: Time range (e.x. '17:00-19:00') for a weekly recurring schedule (Sunday)

options.name: weekly_thursday_time
options.description: Time range (e.x. '17:00-19:00') for a weekly recurring schedule (Thursday)

options.name: weekly_tuesday_time
options.description: Time range (e.x. '17:00-19:00') for a weekly recurring schedule (Tuesday)

options.name: weekly_wednesday_time
options.description: Time range (e.x. '17:00-19:00') for a weekly recurring schedule (Wednesday)
